qa_pairs.question: What information is required to configure a new Nextcloud remote device profile using `rclone`?
qa_pairs.answer: To configure a new Nextcloud remote device profile with `rclone`, you will need to provide a name for the remote (e.g., "nextcloud"), select "WebDAV" as the storage type, specify the URL `https://nextcloud.computecanada.ca/remote.php/dav/files/<your CCDB username>`, identify the WebDAV site as "Nextcloud", and enter your CCDB username and password.

qa_pairs.question: What is the specific URL that should be used when setting up `rclone` for the Alliance Nextcloud service?
qa_pairs.answer: When configuring `rclone` for the Alliance Nextcloud service, the URL to enter for the "URL of http host to connect to" prompt is `https://nextcloud.computecanada.ca/remote.php/dav/files/<your CCDB username>`.
